name: SkillsBench v1.1
protocol: Source export protocol; row-level protocol details are preserved when available.

explanation.en: A trial passes only if every deterministic pytest assertion succeeds; with curated Agent Skills provided, results are averaged over three trials per task, then across the 87 v1.1 tasks.
explanation.zh: 只有 verifier 的全部确定性 pytest 断言都通过，trial 才算通过；在提供精选 Agent Skills 的条件下，先对每题 3 次 trial 取平均，再对 v1.1 的 87 题取平均。

summary.en: SkillsBench measures how well agents complete expert workflows in containers when given curated Agent Skills.
summary.zh: SkillsBench 评估 agent 在容器中借助精选 Agent Skills 完成专业工作流的能力。

task_format.en: In a Docker container with a skills folder, the agent completes one of 87 tasks across 8 domains and leaves outputs for a deterministic pytest verifier.
task_format.zh: agent 在带有 skills 目录的 Docker 容器中完成 8 个领域共 87 个任务之一，并留下供确定性 pytest verifier 检查的输出。
